note: Finding eggs and young beside the dead (roadmap item 55). One roll per foe lying dead, from the finder's own seeded dice, never the dynasty's. Chance = base x place x species rarity x the finder's skill. Only creatures that are born (data/creatures) can leave young; bosses are never searched, so a legend's clutch comes with the Explore events later.

text.full: There are young beside the dead {parent}, but there is nowhere to keep them.
text.empty: None yet. After a hunt, search the bodies: a creature that is born may have left an egg or young beside it. Rangers, druids and beastmasters have the best eye for it.
text.note: Eggs and young found beside the dead. They grow with the years and cost gold to keep; left unkept, an egg spoils and a creature wanders off.
